purpose: Deterministically free automation capacity while preserving the most-used active tasks.

algorithm.ordering: stable task identifier order when multiple candidates exist

ordering: stable task identifier as final tie-breaker

evidence_rules: Use authoritative automation metadata available at decision time.
Do not infer run_count when the platform does not expose it.
If run_count is unavailable and never-run elimination is insufficient, HOLD rather than fabricate a least-run ordering; obtain an authoritative count or equivalent execution history first.
Disabling a task is a capacity-management effect, not evidence that the task's underlying work is complete.
Preserve task history and do not reinterpret disabled work as DONE.
scope: ChatGPT automation/task capacity management for QIK-VRT work and analogous capacity-constrained task sets.
